subject: road-fleet
q: THE WORL TRUCK, or THE WORK TRUCK? Bryn, Abbi and Cyrena take it into town either way.
detail: ANSWERED: IT IS THE WORK TRUCK. A slip of the thumb after all — AND ASKING COST ONE LINE WHILE GUESSING WOULD HAVE COST A NAME. FILED AS GIVEN AND NOT NORMALISED. WORL may be a name, a tribe word, a decal, or a slip of the thumb — and the Archive has learned the hard way what happens when it tidies a spelling it does not understand. One word, unruled.
